### Imports

```{r}
library("stringr")
library("DESeq2")
library("EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86")
library("dplyr")
library("ggplot2")
library("ggrepel")
library("ggpubr")
library("writexl")
```

```{r}
date_str <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")
date_str

set.seed(42)
```


### Annotation file for samples
```{r}
annot_table <- read.table("../GSE102485_series_matrix.txt",
                          sep = "\t", fill = TRUE, skip = 30, header = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Build a more focused annotation title with sample name, source, disease and tissue
sample_annot <- data.frame("title" = colnames(annot_table)[2:31])
sample_annot["source"] <- unlist(annot_table[7, 2:31])
sample_annot["disease"] <- unlist(annot_table[9, 2:31])
sample_annot["tissue"] <- unlist(annot_table[10, 2:31])
```

```{r}
# Keep only samples that are from normal retinas or diabetes membranes
uninteresting_samples <- sample_annot$title %in% c("Bp2", "Bp3", "Bp4", "IIr1", "IIr2", "Rp1", "Rp2")
sample_annot <- sample_annot[!uninteresting_samples, ]
sample_annot["group"] <- ifelse(sample_annot$source == "retina", "Normal", "Disease")

rownames(sample_annot) <- sample_annot$title

sample_annot$source <- factor(sample_annot$source)
sample_annot$tissue <- factor(sample_annot$tissue)
sample_annot$disease <- factor(sample_annot$disease)
sample_annot$group <- factor(sample_annot$group)
```

### Process the dataset

```{r}
full_count_table <- read.table("../GSE102485_expressed_gene_reads.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE, quote = "")

# Drop columns that don't seem to have a clear meaning
trimmed_count_table <- full_count_table[, c(1:37)]

counts <- trimmed_count_table[, c(1:31)]
rownames(counts) <- counts$Gene
counts[, 1] <- NULL

rownames(counts) <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(counts))

counts <- counts[, !uninteresting_samples]
```

```{r}
# Check that rownames of annotation table are identical to count columns
identical(rownames(sample_annot), colnames(counts))
```
```{r}
# Create the deseq object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = as.matrix(counts),
                              colData = sample_annot,
                              design = ~ group)
```


```{r}
# Do some suggested pre-filtering to counts for DESeq2
# I.e. keep only features that have at least a count of 10 in at least 3 different samples. Normal samples 3 
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3
dds <- dds[keep, ]
```

```{r}
# Explicitly set the reference level to match the normal group
dds$group <- relevel(dds$group, ref = "Normal")
```

```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```


```{r}
dds_res <- as.data.frame(results(dds))
```

```{r}
# Translate ensembl names to symbols
edb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86

ens_to_gene <- ensembldb::select(edb, keys = rownames(dds_res),
                      keytype = "GENEID",
                      columns = c("GENEID", "GENENAME"))
```

```{r}
dds_res_w_symbols <- merge.data.frame(dds_res, ens_to_gene,
                                      by.x = 0, by.y = "GENEID")
```

```{r}

dds_res_filt <- dds_res_w_symbols[abs(dds_res_w_symbols$log2FoldChange) > 1 & dds_res_w_symbols$padj < 0.05 & complete.cases(dds_res_w_symbols), ]
```

```{r}
volcano_from_deseq_res <- function(res,
                               #res_df_filt,
                               annot_genes,
                               title="STAND IN TITLE", 
                               save=FALSE,
                               specific_font="",
                               label_size=3,
                               text_size=11,
                               remove_legend=FALSE,
                               file_name_to_save=""
                               ) {
  print(annot_genes)
  
  res_df <- data.frame(res)
  res_df$log_padj <- -log10(res_df$padj)
  res_df$ensemble <- rownames(res_df)
  
  volc_res_df <- res_df
  
  volc_res_df %>%
    mutate(status = case_when(
      log2FoldChange >= 1 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "Up-regulated in FVM",
      log2FoldChange <= -1 & padj <= 0.05 ~ "Down-regulated in FVM",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )) -> volc_res_df
  
  volc_p <- ggscatter(volc_res_df, x="log2FoldChange", y="log_padj",
                      color = 'status',
                      palette = c("blue","gray","red"),
                      size=3, alpha=0.5, repel=TRUE,
                      ylab="-log10(Adjusted p-value)",
                      xlab="log2FoldChange") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1.3, linetype="dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype="dashed") +
    ggtitle(title) +
    xlim(-22, 22) + 
    ylim(0, 40) +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.85, 0.9),
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.background = element_blank()) +
    geom_label_repel(
      data=subset(volc_res_df, (!is.na(GENENAME) &
                                  GENENAME %in% annot_genes)),
      aes(label=GENENAME),
      size = label_size,
      box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
      point.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      family = specific_font,
      fontface = 'italic'
    )
  
  if (specific_font != "") {
    volc_p <- volc_p +
      theme(text = element_text(size = text_size,
                                family = specific_font))
  }
  
  if (remove_legend) {
    volc_p <- volc_p + 
      theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  
  if (save) {
      ggsave(paste0(file_name_to_save, "_volcano", ".png"),
               plot = volc_p, path = "volcano_plots",
             width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
      ggsave(paste0(file_name_to_save, "_volcano", ".pdf"),
               plot = volc_p, path = "volcano_plots",
             width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  }
  
  print(volc_p)
}
```

### Boxplots of DESeq2 normalized counts
```{r}
# Copied from the bulk OIR script
deseq_plotcounts_to_boxplot <- function(gene,
                                        dds,
                                        save=FALSE,
                                        gene_name_db=ens_to_gene,
                                        y_ax_lab_text_size=10,
                                        y_ax_tick_text_size=10,
                                        x_ax_text_size=10,
                                        title_text_size=10) {
  gene_symbol <- gene_name_db$GENEID[gene_name_db$GENENAME == gene]
  count_data <- plotCounts(dds = dds,
           gene = gene_symbol,
           intgroup = c("group"),
           main = "",
           xlab = "Group",
           returnData = TRUE)
  #count_data <- count_data[grep("P17", count_data$simple_group), ]
  #count_data$simple_group <- sub("P17", "", count_data$simple_group)
  
  box_p <- ggplot(count_data,
       aes(x = group,
           y = count,
           fill = group),) + 
  #scale_y_log10() + 
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.3) +
  ggtitle(gene) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Normalized count") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_text(
          face = "bold", size = y_ax_lab_text_size
        ),
        axis.text.y = element_text(
          size = y_ax_tick_text_size
        ),
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          face = "bold", size = x_ax_text_size
        ),
        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold.italic", size = title_text_size
        )) + 
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Disease" = "FVMs"))
  
  print(box_p)
  
  if (save) {
    ggsave(paste0(gene, "_GSE102485_boxplot_", date_str, ".png"),
               plot = box_p, path = "boxplots",
             width = 4, height = 6, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(paste0(gene, "_GSE102485_boxplot_", date_str, ".pdf"),
                   plot = box_p, path = "boxplots",
                 width = 4, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

### Figure 3C and supplementary figure S6A
```{r}
genes = c("POSTN", "PLVAP", "FOLR2", "CSF1", "CSF1R", "IL34", "GAS6", "MERTK", "CXCL12", "CXCR4", "NOTCH3", "DLL4", "ADGRE5", "CD55")

for (gene in genes) {
  deseq_plotcounts_to_boxplot(gene = gene,
                            dds = dds,
                            save = TRUE,
                            y_ax_lab_text_size = 15,
                            y_ax_tick_text_size = 12,
                            x_ax_text_size = 15,
                            title_text_size = 20)
}
```
